name: Jasper
note: Sale dates are announced but no parcel lists are posted.

auction.venue: Jasper County Courthouse (the county guide says sales occur at the Courthouse)
auction.time: First Tuesday of the month when a sale is held, between 10:00 am and 4:00 pm; the following Wednesday if the first Tuesday is a legal holiday. The June 2, 2026 sale was announced for 1:30 pm.
auction.payment: Cash, certified check or money order, paid in full. The time to remit payment is set on the day of the sale.
vital: Buyer beware sale with no guarantees expressed or implied. The county advises against buying property you have not seen.
The opening bid is the tax due plus penalties, interest and costs. A property with no bid can be offered again that day at the levy officer's discretion.
The Sheriff's Tax Deed and transfer tax form are completed and recorded within 30 days. The levy officer may rescind any sale within 30 days with a full refund.
Redemption runs 12 months: bid plus taxes paid plus a 20% premium for the first year and 10% for each additional year. The buyer may not take possession before then.
The buyer is responsible for future taxes and assessments. Municipal tax sales follow the same procedures.
auction.confirmed: Checked 2026-10-03. Tax Sales page reads no tax sales at this time; last sale notice posted 2026-05-27 for June 2, 2026. Rules from the county Delinquent Tax Sale Information PDF (uploaded 2024-12, document dated 2017). Courthouse street address is not stated in the guide.
